exact_words: The match plus its setup and teardown. Confirm it by {date}, {time}, or the hold lapses.

test: "OK, next request" brings back "Request a slot" and unlocks the form, still holding what she typed
what_should_happen: Deepa requests Ground B, Practice, 09:00 to 10:00, pencils it in and presses "OK, next request". The panel says "Request a slot" again and the form is unlocked, still showing Ground B, Practice, 09:00, 10:00 and the club.

test: by keyboard: Tab to the card and Enter puts it in its slot, then "OK, next request" has the focus
what_should_happen: Without a mouse, Tab reaches the booking card and Enter puts it in its slot. When the hold has spread, "OK, next request" already has the focus, so Enter goes on to the next request.

test: on a phone a finger tap on the card puts it in its slot as a drag does
what_should_happen: On a phone nothing can be dragged, so a finger tap on the card does the same job. The card goes into its slot and the caption says "Holding the ground…".

reason: The panel sitting under the form at phone width needs a real browser's layout.
